children.text: Algeria's short-term tourist visa allows tourists a short-term visit to Algeria. Citizens of Georgia apply for this visa at the consulate in Ankara, Turkey, where the applicant's presence is not required.

The final decision on issuing the sticker visa is made by the consulate in Ankara, Turkey. The applicant submits documents in person, at a pre-arranged appointment (if a third party, i.e., a representative, is handling the case, the representative submits the documents on the applicant's behalf). Before this step, the following must be completed:

🔹Receive the visa decision.

Processing of the visa application begins once the documents are submitted to the consulate, and review times vary case by case. The application may be approved the same day or within the next 3-5 days.
The validity period of the tourist visa is determined by the applicant's travel dates. Accordingly, the consulate pays close attention to the dates in the submitted documents.

If you have additional supporting documents, submit them to the consulate translated and certified.
It's recommended to apply for your visa at least 2 months before your trip, as the consulate has no fixed processing time.
The consulate fully reserves the right to request additional documentation from the applicant.
It's important to remember and not exceed the rights and obligations granted by your visa category.

content.text: What determines whether I'll get a visa?

children.text: It's difficult to predict the likelihood of a specific applicant being granted a visa. However, it's clear that this depends on your close ties to your home country. Clear proof of your travel purpose is also important.

content.text: Can the consulate's decision on a visa be guaranteed or challenged?

children.text: No one else can interfere with the consul's decision on issuing a visa. This decision is final. However, our qualified professionals will do everything possible to prepare your documents properly and in your favor for the consulate, so the consul fully understands your current circumstances and prospects, which increases the likelihood of the visa being granted.
